    Two-sided unit orbits of morphisms #

    This file constructs the underlying sets of rays used in the BGRS ray category. Two morphisms with the same endpoints define the same unit ray when they differ by invertible endomorphisms at the source and target.

    Only the Hom-set quotient is constructed here. In particular, it is not a categorical quotient: composition in the BGRS ray category has a special zero case and is not induced by ordinary composition of representatives.

    def LargeIndecomposable.UnitRayEquivalent {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) :
    Prop

    Two morphisms lie in the same two-sided orbit under invertible endpoint endomorphisms. This is the underlying equivalence relation defining a ray.

                    class LargeIndecomposable.HasClassifyingComparableUnitRaySpans (k : Type w) [Field k] (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] :
                    Prop

                    The two source properties of a distributive category used to make the set of rays finite: principal subbimodules classify unit rays, and those principal subbimodules form a chain in every Hom space.
